mapper.select: select mn.* from Me_Brand_Recommend_Dtl mn where mn.Br_Id = #{brId} order by mn.Brd_Sort ASC

select pro.P_Name as pName, sec.Sec_Name as secName, f.File_Relation_Id as fileRelationId, mn.* from Me_Brand_Recommend mn left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id = mn.Sec_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileId = mn.Br_Id where mn.Br_Id = #{id}
